name: GenEval
intro: GenEval 是面向文本到图像模型的对象组合评测。它用六类模板任务、MS-COCO 对象词表和自动感知模型，逐图验证对象存在、计数、颜色、位置与属性绑定是否满足提示。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, LAION
build_method: 任务模板, MS-COCO对象词表, 自动感知验证, 人工一致性检验
task_type: 文本到图像生成, 组合对齐
eval_feature: 6类组合任务, 目标检测与CLIP验证, 二元逐图判定
scale: 553个提示；每个模型每提示生成4张图
build_method_en: Task Templates, MS-COCO Object Vocabulary, Automated Perceptual Verification, Human Agreement Check
eval_feature_en: Six Compositional Tasks, Detection and CLIP Verification, Binary Per-image Correctness
intro_en: GenEval evaluates object compositionality in text-to-image models. Six templated tasks, an MS-COCO object vocabulary, and automated perceptual models verify whether each image satisfies requested objects, counts, colors, positions, and attribute bindings.
scale_en: 553 prompts; four generated images per prompt for each model

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2310.11513v1 and official repository revision af4902f24d3ca90ebbb446dd9891a59e0f82725f; there is no separate official dataset, because the prompt generator, fixed prompt metadata, and evaluator are published inside the repository. Six task templates use 80 MS-COCO object classes, 10 colors, counts 2–4, and four positions. With seed 43, the generator includes all 80 single-object prompts, samples 100 candidates for each of the other five tasks, and deduplicates YAML-form metadata. The pinned prompt set has 553 items with exact task counts 80 single object, 99 two object, 80 counting, 94 colors, 100 position, and 100 color attribute binding. The paper evaluates four images per prompt while leaving generation settings at each model's defaults. COCO Mask2Former uses confidence 0.3 except 0.9 for counting and retains at most 16 objects per class. Include/exclude clauses check presence and exact counts; relative position uses center offsets after a 0.1 size-proportional dead zone and direction components beyond 0.5. CLIP ViT-L/14 classifies 10 candidate colors from bounding-box crops masked onto #999 gray. Each image receives binary correctness only when every requested clause passes, with a diagnostic reason on failure. Task scores average image correctness; the overall GenEval score is the unweighted mean of the six task scores. Human validation collects 6,000 annotations over 1,200 images, five annotators per image: GenEval agreement is 83% versus 88% pairwise inter-annotator agreement, and 91% on the 860 unanimous examples.
